source.source_name: CVR-permanent — Det Centrale Virksomhedsregister (base company data)
source.license: Free reuse incl. commercial under CVR-loven; honour reklamebeskyttelse flag

access.credential_acquisition: Request free HTTP Basic credentials by emailing cvrselvbetjening@erst.dk and signing the protected-data (address protection) declaration.

pagination.note: Elasticsearch 1.7.x. A single _search is capped at 3,000 docs. Full extraction uses the scroll API: POST /{index}/_search?scroll=1m then POST /_search/scroll with the returned _scroll_id. Indexes: virksomhed, produktionsenhed, deltager.

transport.rate_limit: max 3,000 docs per query; use scroll for bulk; be polite

parsing.notes: Most attributes are arrays of period-stamped values (periode.gyldigFra/gyldigTil); resolve the current entry (gyldigTil == null) or read the virksomhedMetadata rollup. Exact nesting under Vrvirksomhed must be confirmed against a real authenticated response. attributter[] is a typed list — KAPITAL and FORMÅL are stored as string values with a type discriminator.

mapping_rules.legal_name: Current navne[] entry where periode.gyldigTil is null (or virksomhedMetadata.nyesteNavn).
mapping_rules.dissolution_date: Close of the last livsforloeb period when status is OPLØST.
mapping_rules.registered_address: Current beliggenhedsadresse[]; expose kommune code for geography.
mapping_rules.share_capital: attributter[] entry of type KAPITAL (+ currency attribute).
mapping_rules.advertising_protection: Carry the reklamebeskyttelse flag through to gate marketing use.

fixture_requirements: representative active ApS/AS with current navne + virksomhedsform + status + beliggenhedsadresse + hovedbranche + KAPITAL
entity with name history (multiple navne[] periods, prior gyldigTil set)
dissolved/bankrupt entity (status UNDER KONKURS / OPLØST with closed livsforloeb)
entity with deltagerRelation incl. beneficial owners (reelle ejere)

live_test_plan.smoke: With credentials, POST /cvr-permanent/virksomhed/_search {"query":{"term":{"cvrNummer":22756214}}}; assert one hit with cvrNummer + current navne. Confirm 401 without auth.
live_test_plan.full: Scroll virksomhed (2,194,982), produktionsenhed (2,787,126), deltager (1,772,344) behind explicit env gates; refresh incrementally where a sidstOpdateret-equivalent exists.

blockers: Requires free HTTP Basic credentials obtained via email (cvrselvbetjening@erst.dk) and a signed protected-data declaration — cannot be automated unattended.
No raw records inspected yet (401 without auth); exact JSON nesting under Vrvirksomhed unconfirmed.
deltager / reelle ejere data is personal data — GDPR + address-protection handling required before ingestion.
